name: Elegance Catamaran Cruises
summary: An owner-operated catamaran, Elegance, sailing out of Bridgetown for lunch and sunset cruises with snorkel stops at the shipwrecks and with turtles. The lunch cruise takes no more than 12 guests, and taxi transfers, food and an open bar are part of the price. The boat can also be chartered privately for the day.
standouts: Taxi transfers included on shared cruises
Private daily charters with menu choices such as lobster, lamb or sushi on request

trips.title: Lunch Cruise
trips.summary: A sail out of Bridgetown along the coast, with stops to swim, snorkel over shipwrecks and swim with turtles. The crew serve a Bajan buffet lunch in a quiet bay before the sail back. No more than 12 guests come aboard.
highlights: Snorkel at the shipwrecks and swim with turtles
Bajan buffet lunch in a quiet bay

trips.title: Sunset Dinner Cruise
trips.summary: A four hour evening cruise from 3pm to 7pm, with a turtle swim and snorkelling before dinner on board as the sun goes down. Dinner, an open bar and taxi transfers are included.

trips.title: Private Cruise
trips.summary: Elegance can be chartered privately for the day, with the plan built around your group, from a breakfast trip to a wedding, birthday or anniversary on board. A Bajan lunch, drinks and transfers are included, and other menus can be arranged for an extra charge.
highlights: Lobster, lamb or sushi menus on request at a surcharge
Weddings, birthdays and anniversaries on board
trips.checkNotes: Price on application. Booked by choosing 'Private/Customised Cruise' on the booking request form, or by email or phone.

checkNotes: Trading check: the site's page dates run to 2021 and WordPress pages show no 2025 or 2026 prices or news. The booking form is still up and its card expiry list starts at 2024, so the form was touched after 2023; treated as trading, but worth confirming by phone. Booking form terms: cancelling with less than 48 hours notice incurs a charge, and same-day cancellation is charged in full. No street address or departure dock is given; the lunch cruise sails out of Bridgetown. The home page links to Facebook, Instagram and TripAdvisor (not opened).
